nodes.name: Prepare one application handoff row per role
Download the recruiter handoff CSV
Workflow overview and setup

parameters.content:
## Build a recruiter-requested hiring campaign

### How it works
A recruiter requests one role spotlight or a multi-role roundup using a form. The workflow matches the brief to approved open jobs, builds one campaign video, and prepares tracked application links and employee referral copy in a downloadable CSV. A campaign log prevents duplicate completed campaigns and resumes saved jobs using the original snapshot. Review all media and copy before sharing manually.

### Setup
1. Install **`@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid`** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Create a **Zvid API** credential with [your key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys), Base URL `https://api.zvid.io`, and select it on every Zvid node.
3. Connect Google Sheets nodes to one document: the job catalog plus Hiring Campaigns. Add the exact headers in the [setup guide](https://github.com/Zvid-io/zvid-n8n/blob/master/workflows/were-hiring-video.md).
4. Supply JobKey, Role, Approval=approved and ApplyUrl. Set careersUrl and a manualBrief; configure a Basic Auth credential for the recruiter form.
5. **dryRun=false spends credits.** true returns the plan, JSON and quote only; no editor draft or log writes.
6. Test manually, inspect the video and handoff, then enable the protected form. Avoid overlapping runs; keep job IDs for recovery.

### Customization
Reuse CampaignKey to resume; change it only for an intentional new campaign.

nodes.name: 1. Receive a recruiter brief

parameters.content:
## 1. Receive a recruiter brief

Choose spotlight with one JobKey, or roundup filtered by Team, Location or JobKeys. Configure Basic Auth for the form. Manual tests use manualBrief.

nodes.name: 2. Match approved openings to the brief

parameters.content:
## 2. Match approved openings to the brief

Read the job catalog and Hiring Campaigns log. Match explicit roles, check approval and open dates, then prioritize closing dates. Explain missing or ineligible selections before rendering.

nodes.name: 3. Compose spotlight or roundup and check cost

parameters.content:
## 3. Compose spotlight or roundup and check cost

Saved jobs use their original campaign snapshot. New campaigns validate their design and credit ceiling. dryRun=true returns the full plan, design and quote without logging or rendering.

nodes.name: 4. Reserve the campaign and save its accepted job

parameters.content:
## 4. Reserve the campaign and save its accepted job

Save submitting before the paid request, then persist the accepted job ID. No paid submission retries. Run one execution at a time; a Sheets log is not an atomic lock.

nodes.name: 5. Wait for completion and record the outcome

parameters.content:
## 5. Wait for completion and record the outcome

Zvid polls the saved job within the deadline. Inspect failed or uncertain jobs before resetting state. Log headers: CampaignKey, Status, JobId, CreditsQuoted, VideoUrl, Caption, PlanJson, CompletedAt.

nodes.name: 6. Review the recruitment campaign handoff

parameters.content:
## 6. Review the recruitment campaign handoff

Open Watch video → Binary → data → View. Download the CSV for role links and employee referral copy. Review and share manually; no applications are evaluated and no messages are sent.
